result: In `sync_fifo_core`, add a parameterized head-data register and drive `out_data` from it instead of the asynchronous `mem[rd_ptr]` read; update it when a push enters an empty FIFO and when a pop advances to a remaining queued word. Handle the single-word case explicitly: when the only queued word is popped while a push is accepted on the same edge, load the new input as the head; when a pop advances through a larger FIFO, select the next oldest stored word. Preserve the existing pointers, occupancy, full simultaneous pop/push behavior, reset priority, stall stability, symbolic payload width, supported non-power-of-two depths, and top `// @latency 1` annotation; invalid-cycle `out_data` remains unspecified.
